title: Minimum Common Value of Sorted Arrays
description: Given two non-empty sorted integer arrays, return their smallest value that occurs in both arrays. Return -1 if they have no common value. Input: `nums1`, `nums2`. Output: the minimum common value or -1.
constraints: Both arrays are sorted in non-decreasing order
hints: Sort once or track a compact running state to avoid checking every possible group.
Test duplicates, extreme ordering, and cases with no feasible candidate.
